name: Meteostat climate normals
publisher: Meteostat and its data providers (national weather services)

measures.definition: Sunshine duration measured at the nearest station, summed over the year, from the latest 30-year normal Meteostat holds.
Sunshine duration measured at the nearest station, by month.

coverage.geography: patchy: stations whose normals include sunshine

rights.attribution: Source: Meteostat (meteostat.net) and its data providers (dev.meteostat.net/providers), CC BY 4.0

vetted.notes: Fills sunshine where the WMO set has no station (Lisbon, Turin). No CORS, so CLI and MCP only.

caveats: Credit Meteostat and the original weather service.

Product: the bulk normals files (bulk.meteostat.net/v2/normals/<station>.csv.gz), sunshine in minutes. Whether Meteostat fills gaps in normals with model data is not documented for this product; unverified.
